graphs.title: The concentration falls as the final volume rises.
graphs.label: Concentration

sentences: Make the final volume 25 cm3, then 250 cm3, and compare.
title: Diluting a solution
goal: See how adding water lowers the concentration of a solution.
note: When you add water to a solution the amount of solute stays the same, so M1 V1 = M2 V2. Here 25 cm3 of a 2 mol/dm3 solution is made up to a larger volume.
hints: Adding water does not change the amount of dissolved substance.
What happens to the volume when you add water?
A bigger volume holding the same amount means a lower concentration.
